interpretation: The visual scale injection worked exactly, but the initialized two-view baseline was only 3.7 to 14.8 mm.
Bundle 200 already existed as an inertially propagated backend state before visual initialization. Its backend trajectory was nearly invariant to the 0.5x and 2x visual scale changes.
The live frontend streams diverged at bundle 201, when backend writeback first acted on the differently scaled maps. The three live arms therefore do not prove metric-scale convergence.
Directly seeding the bundle-200 backend pose was rejected by the first solve. The inherited previsual backend state and prior chain overwhelmed the visual handoff.
The metric latch fired on the frontend pair [0, 200] after bundle 200 became fixed and bundle 0 was absent from the backend. Its unity ratio is not a metric-readiness measurement.

decision.next_bounded_experiment: Reconstruct the backend at visual success with both initializer keyframes and buffered IMU. Do not treat a pose overwrite as a repair.
